# Was Spotify hacked?

**Not established.** No source we read says the Nov 24 outage was an attack, and none rules one out. Spotify has not given a cause. Being logged out does not by itself show a hack.

Incident: Spotify login outage, Nov 24 2026. Also reported as the Spotify outage, Spotify down and Spotify logged me out. First published Nov 24, 2026; last updated Nov 24, 2026, 7:30 AM ET.

Picture: The Spotify app playing music on a smartphone (resized). Not taken during this outage. Image: Unsplash, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spotify_on_smartphone_(Unsplash).jpg).

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Spotify, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 24, 2026, 7:30 AM ET: **Spotify's Nov 24 login outage lasted about an hour. Spotify has not given a cause, and nobody has reported a hack.** First draft. 5 sources (all Tier 2), 8 claims (2 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 2 Not established), 4 questions. The outage and Spotify's acknowledgement are Confirmed by a first-hand check and several outlets. Recovery is Reported: one outlet's first-hand check and a Spotify post relayed by one outlet. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. Spotify users in at least a dozen countries reported login problems, with more than 16,500 Downdetector reports in the US alone. Spotify has not said how many people were affected.
- Who is affected: Spotify users on the morning of Nov 24 (US time) who were logged out and could not sign back in. Sign-ins were working again for many by about 7:15 AM ET. Users still having trouble can contact Spotify support.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 16,500+ | US Downdetector reports | Plus 8,000+ in the UK, per TechRadar |
| ~6:15 AM ET | Problems began | Other outlets say 6:32-6:34 AM ET |
| ~7:15 AM ET | Sign-ins working again | Per TechRadar; Spotify gave no end time |

### Known so far

- On the morning of Nov 24, many Spotify users were logged out and could not sign back in.
- Spotify's status account said it was aware of issues and checking them out. It gave no cause.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. Spotify has not said.
- Whether it was a cyberattack. No one has claimed one, reported one, or ruled one out.
- How many people were affected.
- When the problem was fully fixed. Spotify has not given an end time.
